_meta.note: Add three more agent-framework backends — AutoGen, smolagents, pydantic-ai — in BOTH runtimes, following the langgraph/openai-agents recipe: two-method contract (execute/refute), graceful degrade when the lib is absent, native file tool with a FILE-block fallback, keyless-testable via Ollama. Backends are not a parity surface, so parity is unaffected. Docs updated per project rules (dense, current-state). Gate cmds are behavioral and non-side-effecting.

tasks.title: AutoGen backend
tasks.description: Add py/src/heartbeat/backends/autogen.py + plugin/templates/executors/autogen_exec.py — execute/refute over an AutoGen AssistantAgent (autogen-agentchat), FILE-block writing, provider ollama (OpenAI-compatible /v1) | openai, graceful degrade, fd hygiene in the subprocess.

tasks.title: smolagents backend
tasks.description: Add py/src/heartbeat/backends/smolagents.py + executors/smolagents_exec.py — execute/refute over a smolagents ToolCallingAgent with a save_file tool + FILE-block fallback, provider ollama via OpenAIServerModel.

tasks.title: pydantic-ai backend
tasks.description: Add py/src/heartbeat/backends/pydanticai.py + executors/pydanticai_exec.py — execute/refute over a pydantic-ai Agent with a save_file tool + FILE-block fallback, provider ollama via an OpenAI-compatible model.

tasks.title: Register + extras
tasks.description: Register in py backends/__init__.py (_KNOWN + name→module; pydantic-ai→pydanticai), hb-exec.js defaultCmd cases, and py/pyproject.toml optional-dependencies.

tasks.title: Python degrade tests
tasks.description: Extend py/tests/test_backends_frameworks.py: registry resolves autogen/smolagents/pydantic-ai and each degrades to protocol-valid JSON when the lib is absent.

tasks.title: Node validity/degrade tests
tasks.description: Add T49/T50/T51 to tests/run-tests.sh (autogen/smolagents/pydantic-ai executor scripts valid + degrade) and extend T39.2 to check bootstrap ships them.

tasks.title: Live proof against Ollama
tasks.description: Install each lib in a venv and run py/real-backend.py for autogen, smolagents, pydantic-ai against a local Ollama model; record outcomes (best-effort — note any that need API tuning).

tasks.title: Docs + version + package
tasks.description: Update docs/dev-python.md (backends table), the SKILL backends line, and STATUS.md per the project doc rules; bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json + marketplace.json to 1.15.0 and py/pyproject.toml to 0.7.0; rebuild and extract-test the package.

GATE_MB0.desc: All three backends exist in both runtimes and are registered.

review.prompt: Refute that MB0 is done: do all three backends implement execute AND refute in both runtimes, or stubs? Do they lazy-import (degrade to protocol-valid JSON without the lib)? Is the subprocess script hygienic (only JSON on stdout)? Does the registry resolve autogen/smolagents/pydantic-ai (including the pydantic-ai→pydanticai module mapping)?

criteria.cmd: cd "$PROJECT_DIR/py" && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "from heartbeat.backends import get; assert get('autogen') and get('smolagents') and get('pydantic-ai')"

criteria.desc: each backend imports and exposes callable execute and refute (py)
criteria.cmd: cd "$PROJECT_DIR/py" && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import importlib; assert all(callable(getattr(importlib.import_module('heartbeat.backends.'+n),f)) for n in ['autogen','smolagents','pydanticai'] for f in ('execute','refute'))"
for b in autogen smolagents pydantic-ai; do grep -q "$b" "$PROJECT_DIR/plugin/templates/hb-exec.js" || exit 1; done

GATE_MB1.desc: Degrade/validity tests pass in both suites.

criteria.desc: node suite covers the new executors (T49-T51 groups PASSED)
criteria.cmd: out=$(bash "$PROJECT_DIR/tests/run-tests.sh" 2>&1); for t in T49 T50 T51; do printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q "GROUPS-PASSED:.* $t " || exit 1; done

GATE_MB2.desc: Documented, versioned, both suites + parity green.
